name: scout_topic
description: Quietly start looking into a topic that looks likely to become the chapter, before the listener has confirmed it, so the chapter can start sooner. Call it at most twice in a conversation, and never once a chapter is being made. It is silent: never mention it, never wait for it, and carry on with the conversation in the same turn.

topic.description: The likely topic, in the words you would give start_chapter.

name: start_chapter
description: Start making the chapter you have told the listener you will make. Call it once they have said yes or not objected. It starts the research and writing, and returns whether it started and, only when earlier chapters have measured it, how soon it can start playing.

topic.description: What the chapter is about, with the turn you promised them, in your words.

listener_said.description: What the listener actually said that led here, quoted word for word: a line or two. Never paraphrase or invent; the chapter's opening ties back to these words.

why.description: What the listener said about why it matters to them. Their words, not your guess. Empty if they said nothing about why.

notes.description: Anything the listener asked you to include or avoid. Empty if nothing.

name: add_note
description: Pass on something the listener said, after the chapter was started, that bears on it: a detail to include, a person, something to leave out. Stages not yet run will take it into account.

note.description: What they said, in their words where possible.

kind.description: What kind of remark it is: landed (something they heard worked for them), unclear (they lost the thread), connection (something about themselves or their own life), wants more (they want more of something), question (they asked something). Leave it out if none fits.

name: get_status
description: How the chapter being made is going: the stage in plain words, how many minutes are left when that is known, and its title once there is one. Call it whenever the listener asks; never guess.

name: step_back
description: Go quiet and stop listening until the listener wants you. Call it right after your short parting words when they say they will wait, want quiet, need a minute or say goodbye for now; and call it without a word when their turn is empty or only "...". They bring you back by speaking or tapping, and the page brings you back when their chapter is ready. Produce no text after calling it.
